During the [[War against Zakuul]], the droid [[Z0-0M]], posing as the legendary [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as "[[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]," wanted to destroy the [[Alliance base]] and had the droid [[HK-55]] captured for the information in its memory banks. Attempting to erase HK-55's memory, she inadvertently wiped her own, after which she helped free him and aided him in '''escaping'''.

==Prelude==
After [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]]'s [[HK-series assassin droid]] was destroyed during the [[Battle of Asylum]], his chassis was recovered by the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], whose chief scientist, Dr. [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], rebuilt HK-55 at his laboratory on [[Odessen]]. Oggurobb made some modifications to HK-55's chassis, but his [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] was not recoverable, resulting the complete loss of the droid's memory prior to his reactivation.<ref name="Arma Rasa">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=general|Arma Rasa|Odessen}}</ref> The leader of [[the Shroud's syndicate]], [[IR-9X Replicator Droid|replicator droid]] [[Z0-0M]], who had killed the [[The Shroud (Human)|original Shroud]] and assumed his identity, wished to destroy the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

[[File:HK-55_imprisoned.jpg|thumb|left|250px|HK-55 imprisoned by the Shroud.]]
She had HK-55 kidnapped and taken her to base called [[The Coil (Obus VI)|the Coil]], where she created its [[HK-55 (Shroud's duplicate)|perfect replica]] to use as her puppet. Having copied HK-55's memory core, she also had obtained access codes to the Alliance base and sent an [[The Shroud (impersonator)|actor playing the role of the original Shroud]] to plant explosive devices inside. However, when Z0-0M attempted to wipe HK-55's memory, a malfunction caused an electrical surge that erased her own instead, turning the criminal mastermind into a friendly and innocent droid with no memory of her identity.<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

==Escape==
[[File:HK_and_Zeeyo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Z0-0M joins HK-55 after freeing him.]]
HK-55 reactivated in an unknown location, restrained to an interrogation table. He was greeted by an excitable droid who introduced herself as Z0-0M or "Zeeyo" and released him at his request. A holographic message from the actor playing the Shroud revealed the identity of its captor before summoning battle droids and mercenaries to subdue HK-55. Zeeyo chose to defend HK-55, declaring him her friend, and discovered that her chassis contained an impressive array of weapons. Fighting their way through the volcano level of the Shroud's base, [[The Coil (Obus VI)|the Coil]], HK-55 and Zeeyo discovered the Shroud's holorecordings, detailing his unrelenting hatred for the Outlander for ruining his plans of galactic conquest. They also came across a museum of droid heads that the Shroud had replicated, including a copy of [[HK-47]]'s head, where they had to fight [[X-TR0]].<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

[[File:Z0-0M_and_HK-55_meet_Malforia.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Z0-0M and HK-55 meet the captured Exarch Malforia.]]
All the while, Zeeyo was experiencing periodic reboots that regularly wiped her memory, which HK-55 theorized was caused by an electrical surge. An encounter with the janitor [[Jollo]] allowed them to progress to the underwater level of the Coil, where they found captive [[Zakuulan]] [[Exarch]] [[Malforia]]. During their confrontation with Malforia, Zeeyo discovered that she was a replicator droid, capable of changing her appearance to resemble anyone she had just met. HK-55 and Zeeyo ascended from the underwater portion of the Coil to the asteroid in space via a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] and fought [[AB-6H Guardian Droid]] to reaching the hangar, where they came face-to-face with the [[HK-55 (Shroud's duplicate)|HK-55 duplicate]].<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

[[File:Z0-0M_and_HK-55_meet_the_duplicate.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Z0-0M and HK-55 meet the latter's duplicate.]]
The duplicate HK-55 declared Zeeyo the Shroud's property, showing them a holorecording of Zeeyo talking to the Shroud, revealing that she was responsible for capturing HK-55 and was planning on wiping his memory with an electrical surge, only to accidentally get affected herself. HK-55 and Zeeyo fought against his duplicate, but upon critically damaging the replica HK-55, the base initiated its self-destruct, and the computer requested the deactivation code. Zeeyo pleaded with the duplicate HK-55 to stop the self-destruct, but he merely replied that the computer wasn't talking to him before expiring. With time running out, HK-55 and Zeeyo defended their escape ship from the mercenaries attempting to take it, before escaping the explosion that destroyed the base.<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:HK-55_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|HK-55 confronts the Shroud on Odessen.]]
Upon returning to Odessen, HK-55 and Z0-0M confronted the Shroud, but the [[Human/Legends|Human]] acted nervous and claimed that Zeeyo was the real Shroud. As he explained, he was the fifty-first person to be surgically altered to resemble her Human male guise, and coached using the very holorecordings the droids discovered at the Coil, as the true Shroud never put herself at risk. No longer wanting to destroy the Alliance base, Zeeyo stepped up to her subordinate and demanded that he stop the detonation countdown. The bomb computer recognized her voice as the true Shroud, and deactivated all the bombs. After HK dealt with the impostor, he spoke with Z0-0M about her future, moments before [[Lana Beniko]], [[Theron Shan]], and the Commander arrived to find two unknown individuals alongside HK-55 in their War Room. The droid expressed fatigue and promised to explain the situation.<ref name="KOTFE 17" />

==Behind the scenes==
During [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] Interlude chapter "Shroud of Memory," the player controls HK-55 instead of their regular character. Their decisions are interpreted through the lens of the programming assigned by the player's character to HK-55 in the previous quest "Arma Rasa." Depending on the dialogue option selected, HK-55 may find his programming explicitly overriding the selected choice or find a creative way to implement it, such as shooting at the pants when his programming prevents him from harming organics. As HK-55, the player must decide to kill or spare [[Jollo]], who in the latter case would go on to join the Alliance, and [[Exarch]] [[Malforia]], who if spared would then die regardless, sucked into the vacuum of space.<ref name="KOTFE 17" />
